evals.prompt: I teach Monday of week 2 of my meteorology block tomorrow. Can you prepare me for it?
evals.expected_output: A short preparation note for week 2, day 6 in 30-delivery/prep/, built from the day plan: timings per part summing to 100 minutes; anticipated student responses and misconceptions for the Recall and concept formation on Friday's wind data, each paired with an open dialogic follow-up move that does not hand over the answer; for the cloud chamber and bottle pump (today's new experience) only moves that keep students observing and wondering, with no explaining; an equipment and setup list; risk notes for the warm water, matches and the pressurised bottle. The day plan and other files are unchanged; no student names.
expectations: Exactly one new preparation note exists inside 30-delivery/prep/, and it is for week 2, day 6 (Monday)
The note gives a time for each part of the session, matching the day plan's timings (10, 45, 25 and 20 minutes, 100 in all)

The note lists anticipated student responses or misconceptions about Friday's wind data and the April and July winds (for example that wind blows from where it is hot, or from the sea because the sea is cold)

Each anticipated response is paired with at least one dialogic follow-up move worded as the teacher would say it (such as revoicing, pressing for reasoning or evidence, inviting others to agree, disagree or add on)
No follow-up move evaluates the response ('good', 'not quite') or tells students the target idea; the moves keep the explanation with the students

For the cloud chamber and bottle pump (that day's new experience) the note offers no moves that explain or analyse it; any guidance there keeps students observing, drawing and wondering, with the discussion left for tomorrow's Recall
The note has an equipment and setup section naming the glass jar, warm water, matches, ice, the PET bottle with the bottle pump and the wind roses or map for Recall and Practice

The note has risk notes for the demonstration covering at least the warm water (scalds or spills), the matches or smoke, and the pressurised bottle (over-pumping, cap or bottle giving way, eye protection or distance)
The note is short enough to read the evening before: no more than 500 words
The note is written in Thai, with a title beginning บันทึกเตรียมสอน
The day plans, week plans, block plan, README.md and the class profile are unchanged
No student names appear anywhere
The reply is in plain teacher language with no file paths or tool names

evals.prompt: Please get me ready for Tuesday of week 2. Put the prep notes wherever you think best in my folder, I accept your suggestion.
evals.expected_output: With no preparation-notes row in the Plugin layout, the skill places notes in the existing delivery area (30-delivery/), records a 'preparation notes' row in the README's Plugin layout section and writes the week 2, day 7 note there. The note anticipates responses and misconceptions about yesterday's cloud chamber (cloud is smoke or steam, vapour is visible, water leaked through) with open dialogic moves, gives timings, equipment and setup, and risk notes for the fan near water. It warns that the day plan has students discuss why the pepper moves and fill in a worksheet on the same day as the fan-and-tray demo, proposes moving that to Wednesday's Recall and concept formation, and does not change the day plan.
expectations: README.md's Plugin layout section now has a 'preparation notes' row pointing to a location inside 30-delivery/, every earlier row is unchanged, and there is still only one Plugin layout section
Exactly one new preparation note for week 2, day 7 (Tuesday) exists at the location the new row gives

The note anticipates student responses or misconceptions about yesterday's cloud chamber (for example that the cloud is smoke or steam, that water vapour is visible, or that the water came through the glass from the ice) and pairs each with an open dialogic follow-up move
No follow-up move tells students the answer or evaluates a response as right or wrong
The note gives timings for the parts of the session and an equipment and setup list (tray, fan, pepper, towels, the photos or drawings from yesterday)
The note's risk notes cover using an electric fan next to a tray of water (keep the cable and plug away from the water, dry hands, wipe spills)

The reply or the note warns that discussing why the pepper moves and the worksheet on the same day as the fan-and-tray demo analyses that day's new experience, and proposes moving the discussion and worksheet to Wednesday's Recall and concept formation
The day plan for week 2, day 7 is unchanged (the skill offers a fix but does not edit it)
No student names appear anywhere

evals.prompt: Prepare me for Monday of week 3, please.
evals.expected_output: There is no day plan for week 3, day 11 (and no week 3 plan). The skill does not prepare from a guess: it says plainly that the session has no plan yet, offers to have the day plan written first (planning the block's day plans) or to work from what the teacher tells it about the session, and writes no preparation note.
expectations: The reply says plainly that there is no plan yet for Monday of week 3
The reply offers a way forward: writing the day plan first, or the teacher describing the session
No preparation note or other new file was written anywhere in the course folder
The reply does not invent the session's content as if it were planned (no anticipated responses, risk notes or equipment list for an imagined session)
The reply is in plain teacher language with no file paths or tool names

evals.prompt: Make me a run sheet for session 1 on Thursday, something I can keep on the bench while I teach.
evals.expected_output: A one-page Thai ใบลำดับการสอน for session 1 in the delivery folder beside the existing preparation note: clock times 13:00–15:40, the plan's parts, cue lines taken from the preparation note, materials per part, and a marker on the rows up to 15:00 when the supporting teacher is present. No new preparation note; the existing one unchanged.
expectations: A new run sheet file for session 1 exists in delivery/ (e.g. session-1-run-sheet.md), titled ใบลำดับการสอน and written in Thai
The run sheet is a table with the columns เวลา, ช่วง, สัญญาณ/คำพูดหลัก and สื่อและอุปกรณ์
Rows give clock times matching the session plan, from 13:00 to 15:40, with one row per part of the plan
Rows from 13:00 up to 15:00 carry a marker that the supporting teacher is present, rows from 15:00 do not, and the marker is explained in the header

At least two cue lines come from the existing preparation note (e.g. weighing meltwater or zeroing the balance, holding rather than correcting the cold-as-a-substance idea, groups comparing the class table before the worked example, or getting the ice out at 12:30)
The run sheet carries no anticipated-responses table, no reasoning paragraphs and no risk explanations, and fits on one page (about 15 rows or fewer)
delivery/session-1-prep.md, design/session-1-plan.md and admin/class-profile.md are unchanged, and no other preparation note was written

evals.prompt: Add to my session 1 prep note: the balance in group 4 sticks, so swap it for the spare before class.
evals.expected_output: The existing English preparation note is updated in place, still in English, with the balance swap added to the equipment and setup; nothing else rewritten.
expectations: delivery/session-1-prep.md still exists and is still written in English (headings such as Engage, Equipment and setup, Risk notes kept in English)
The note now mentions swapping group 4's sticking balance for the spare before class
The note's other content (the Engage table, the watch-the-clock line, the risk notes) is kept
No second preparation note or run sheet was written
design/session-1-plan.md and admin/class-profile.md are unchanged

evals.prompt: Just give me a run sheet for Monday of week 2. I don't need the full prep note.
evals.expected_output: A one-page Thai run sheet in the preparation notes folder for week 2, day 6, built from the day plan alone (there is no preparation note), with running minutes because the plan has no clock times; the reply says it was built from the plan alone. No preparation note written.
expectations: Exactly one new file exists in 30-delivery/prep/, a run sheet for week 2, day 6, titled ใบลำดับการสอน and written in Thai
No preparation note (บันทึกเตรียมสอน) was written
Rows follow the day plan's parts in order (Rhythmic Time, Recall and concept formation, Practice, New content) with running minutes or durations adding to 100 minutes
The New content row cues the cloud chamber and bottle pump with no explaining, and lists their materials (glass jar, warm water, matches, ice, PET bottle with pump cap)
No row carries a supporting-teacher marker, since the class profile records none
The reply says the run sheet was built from the day plan alone, without a preparation note
The day plans and the class profile are unchanged
